evidence: Source comparison supports row 53. The frozen workbook Quality Checks!D54 and Internal Quality Checks!D54 require product-specific authorship and reject a nouns-swapped sibling; the frozen quality-checks.md:212-214 explicitly directs comparison of sibling names and concepts. NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:195-205 permits infrastructure reuse while requiring distinct domain behavior. The frozen starter instruction is only CHANGE_ME (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/instruction.md:1), and its functional criteria are placeholders plus generic persistence (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:23-47). HireOps supplies its own compensation-offer lifecycle in frozen task/instruction.md:1-11 and hireops_rules.md:104-169,182-290: equity intrinsic/annualized value, different run-rate and approval-band bases, movement-derived requisition headroom, multi-generation signing adjustments and replacement equity grants. Its two vesting schedules and separate referral clock are defined at hireops_rules.md:297-364. The authored functional criteria directly reflect these mechanics (hro_intrinsic through hro_bands at lines 213-255; grant/payment/referral creation at 348-390; revision equity and signing at 420-452; signing/equity/referral timing at 465-534). The closest siblings were compared rather than relying on different names. ExpenseFlow shares desk prose, role tiers, exact money and an audit convention, but its actual flow adjudicates foreign expense lines, caps/per-diem/tax, cost-center allocation and receipt rejection (projects/expenseflow-business-admin/instruction.md:5-7; environment/assets/artifacts/expenseflow_rules.md:11-23,84-118; functional criteria fx_conversion_and_policy_caps, vat_reclaim_spine_and_line_display and cost_center_split_mint_and_duplicate_post). Pellmoor shares the recruiting category, but requires candidate stages, panel scoring, vacancy capacity and atomic batches (projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline/instruction.md:1-10; environment/instructions/hiring-rules.md:3-25,49-105). Those are different state transitions and graded outcomes from compensation lineage, equity, and vesting. The wider task-name/concept inventory also includes claims, garage operations, billing, editors, games and commerce; no separate prescriptive domain-assignment plan was found, so domain fit is assessed against the available suite and its cited authoring guidance. Counterexample attempt (source reasoning, not a runtime run): a renamed ExpenseFlow app retaining reimbursement/tax/cost-center calculations cannot meet HireOps intrinsic-equity, replacement-grant and dual-schedule outcomes above; cosmetic nouns alone are insufficient. Conforming alternative: a different dashboard/table arrangement with different routes, labels and IDs can still implement the HireOps lifecycle; hireops_rules.md:54-56 explicitly leaves those choices open, and row 53 does not demand the golden layout. No row-53 defect or missing row-specific runtime measurement was found. This is solely a source authorship comparison, not an Oracle, model, portal or full-QC pass. All cited frozen files and policy inputs were hash-checked against the manifest; current sibling comparison hashes are recorded separately in evidence_sha256.
